decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a flagship extension of an established range and has been visible on the website for two years, so the option is performing and costs little to keep, which justifies continued commitment.
The mild sliced cheese launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core business with its own product page, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it on the market costs little.

The sliced butter cheese is a recent, low-cost line extension that uses existing cheesemaking capacity, and one year of evidence is too little to show it will fail, so keeping the option open is reasonable.
